findings.detail: Two wrong options repeat wrong options of the earlier question M1-S04-T1, and the rule allows at most one. Option C (web search sends results straight to synthesis, bypassing the coordinator) mirrors the earlier wrong option in which synthesis calls web search directly. Option D (re-send the original query more times) mirrors the earlier wrong option that re-runs the pipeline with the same original query. The correct option B is also nearly identical to an earlier correct option: send targeted queries on the gaps, then re-invoke synthesis. The same reasoning therefore reaches the answer.

blind_answer.reason: Iterative refinement means re-delegating with targeted queries on the specific gaps found, such as offshore wind subsidies, and then re-invoking synthesis with the new findings. Re-sending the same broad query returns the same sources, so more iterations (D) won't help. Bypassing the synthesis step (A) or bypassing the coordinator (C) breaks the hub-and-spoke design.
